problem: Mateo pulled a little red wagon through the pumpkin patch and loaded it with 6 pumpkins. His grandmother planned to bake pies for the whole street, so she filled her big cart with 4 times as many. How many pumpkins are in her cart?

The Okafor family farm harvested 72 giant pumpkins this fall. That was 8 times as many as the farm next door, where a dry summer left the vines weak. A hayride between the two farms takes 15 minutes. How many giant pumpkins did the farm next door harvest?

follow_ups.question: The farm next door sells each giant pumpkin for 7 dollars. How much money does it make if it sells every one?
How many giant pumpkins did the two farms harvest altogether?

problem: Priya's family carried home 2 pumpkins from the patch, one for each child. The Lindqvists next door were decorating their long front porch, so they carried home 10. The Lindqvists took how many times as many pumpkins as Priya's family?

follow_ups.question: The Lindqvists carve faces into 3 of their pumpkins and leave the rest plain. How many plain pumpkins do they have?

problem: Every October the pumpkin patch builds a straw maze from 26 hay bales. This year the owners also stacked a pumpkin tower by the gate, and it needed 4 times as many bales to stand tall. A scarecrow in an old straw hat guards the tower. Work out the number of hay bales in the tower.

follow_ups.question: The tractor can bring 8 bales on each trip. How many trips did it make to bring the tower's bales?

problem: Nadia's class took a field trip to the pumpkin patch. The teacher bought 18 little gourds for the classroom windowsill. Big pumpkins were heavy to carry onto the bus, so she bought only a third as many of those. How many big pumpkins did she buy?

follow_ups.question: Back at school, each big pumpkin was cut into 4 pieces for an art project. How many pieces were there?
Two of the pieces got too soft and were thrown away. How many good pieces were left?
The good pieces were split equally between the two art tables. How many pieces did each table get?

problem: Lukas entered the weigh-off at the pumpkin patch, and his pumpkin tipped the scale at 9 kilograms. The winning pumpkin weighed 72 kilograms, far more than his. How many times as heavy as Lukas's pumpkin was the winner?

follow_ups.question: Next year Lukas hopes to grow a pumpkin twice as heavy as this one. What weight is he hoping for?
Even at that weight, how many kilograms lighter than this year's winner would it be?

problem: At the craft table, Elif painted faces on 5 small pumpkins. Her brother Tariq had painted pumpkins before and worked quickly, so he painted double that number. What number of pumpkins did Tariq paint?

The farm shop at the pumpkin patch stocks 96 jars of pumpkin jam. Pumpkin butter takes much longer to cook, so the shop has only a quarter as many jars of it. Every jar sells for 6 dollars. How many jars of pumpkin butter does the shop have?

follow_ups.question: By noon, 15 jars of pumpkin butter have been sold. How many are still on the shelf?

problem: Grace showed her rabbit at the county fair and won 3 ribbons. Her cousin Joaquín has shown goats for years, and his goats won 12 ribbons. Compared with Grace, how many times as many ribbons did Joaquín win?

follow_ups.question: Grace pins her new ribbons on a board next to 5 old ones from last year. How many ribbons are on her board now?
Joaquín's board holds his new ribbons plus 4 from earlier fairs. How many more ribbons are on his board than on Grace's?

problem: The county fair's pie contest received 14 apple pies. Cherry pies are what this county is famous for, so the judges had 6 times as many cherry pies to taste. How many cherry pies were entered?

follow_ups.question: Each judge tasted 7 different cherry pies, and each pie had only one judge. How many judges were there?
A quarter of the cherry pies won blue ribbons. How many cherry pies won blue ribbons?
How many cherry pies went home without a blue ribbon?

problem: A giant jar at the county fair held 80 jelly beans. Oliver's guess was only half the real number. A clown was juggling bowling pins next to the table. What was Oliver's guess?

follow_ups.question: His sister guessed 10 more than Oliver. What was her guess?

problem: In the livestock barn at the fair, a young pig weighs 96 kilograms. The lamb in the next pen weighs 8 kilograms and keeps trying to climb the fence. Work out how many times as heavy the pig is as the lamb.
Jamal won 7 tickets at the ring-toss booth. That was only half as many as his friend Arturo won at the duck pond, where Arturo kept picking lucky ducks. How many tickets did Arturo win?

follow_ups.question: They put their tickets together to trade for a prize. How many tickets do they have in all?
A stuffed bear costs 15 tickets. After they get the bear, how many tickets are left?

problem: The Ferris wheel at the county fair gave 63 rides before lunch on Saturday. Each pony ride is long and slow, so the Ferris wheel gave 7 times as many rides as the pony track. The gates had opened at 10 o'clock. How many rides did the pony track give before lunch?

follow_ups.question: A pony ride costs 5 tickets. How many tickets did the pony track collect before lunch?

problem: Two pens sit side by side in the poultry tent. One holds 5 hens, and the other holds 30 fluffy chicks huddled under a warm lamp. The chicks outnumber the hens by how many times?

follow_ups.question: A farmer brings 6 more chicks to that pen. How many chicks are in it now?
Then the chicks are moved into 4 smaller boxes, with the same number in each. How many chicks go in each box?

problem: In the tractor pull at the county fair, a little garden tractor dragged the heavy sled 18 metres before its wheels spun. The champion farm tractor dragged the same sled 6 times as far. How far did the champion tractor pull the sled?

On sports day the blue team scored 36 points in the relay races. The green team kept dropping the baton and ended with only a quarter as many points. The sun was very hot that afternoon. How many points did the green team score?

follow_ups.question: In the tug-of-war the green team earned 15 more points. What is its total now?

problem: For the throwing game at sports day, Ms. Ivanova's class brought 8 bean bags. Altogether, the other classes brought 88. How many times as many bean bags did the other classes bring as Ms. Ivanova's class?

follow_ups.question: The other classes' bean bags are shared out into 4 buckets, the same number in each. How many bean bags are in each bucket?
Ms. Ivanova's class tips its bean bags into one of the buckets. How many are in that bucket now?
During the game, 9 bean bags from that bucket land in the long-jump sand and get left there. How many are left in the bucket?

problem: Hana's best jump-rope score was 9 skips in a row. To show the class how it is done, Coach Bello, who trains boxers, managed 8 times as many skips without stopping. What was the coach's score?

follow_ups.question: After a week of practice, Hana's new score is 4 times her old one. What is her new score?
How many more skips does Hana still need to match Coach Bello?

problem: During the sponsored relay, the oldest class ran 84 laps of the field as a team. The youngest class, whose legs tire quickly, ran a quarter as many laps. Afterwards everyone got an ice lolly from a box of 60. Find the number of laps the youngest class ran.

follow_ups.question: Each lap the youngest class ran raised 3 pounds for charity. How much money did their laps raise?

problem: In the sack race, Leila hopped 20 metres before she tumbled over. Her little brother Omar fell after just 5 metres. How many times as far as Omar did Leila hop?

Sports day ends with the parents' tug-of-war. The children painted 26 paper flags to cheer them on, and the PE teacher ordered 7 times as many plastic flags to line the whole field. The tug-of-war starts at 3 in the afternoon. How many plastic flags did the PE teacher order?

follow_ups.question: The plastic flags are shared equally among 14 classes. How many flags does each class get?
One class loses 4 of its flags in the wind. How many does that class still have?

problem: The water station handed out 45 cups of water on sports day. The orange juice ran out early, so the station handed out a third as many cups of juice. How many cups of juice were handed out?

follow_ups.question: Every cup went into the recycling bin afterwards. How many cups were recycled in all?

problem: Wei's cricket ball slipped out of his hand, and his throw went only 6 metres. Anouk, the school champion, threw the same ball 42 metres. A seagull flew down to peck at the ball where it landed. Anouk's throw was how many times as long as Wei's?

follow_ups.question: On his second try, Wei threw 3 times as far as on his first. How long was his second throw?

problem: The after-school sewing club is making a patchwork blanket for the children's hospital. Amara has cut out 7 red squares. Bianca has a sharper pair of scissors and has cut out 5 times as many blue squares. How many blue squares has Bianca cut out?

follow_ups.question: The blanket needs 50 squares in all. How many more squares do they still have to cut?
Amara cuts all the missing squares herself. How many squares has she cut altogether now?
Sewing each square onto the blanket takes 3 minutes. How long will it take to sew on every square?

problem: Mr. Kowalski carried a big tin of 72 buttons into the sewing club. Last week he left most of his tin at home by mistake, and this week's tin has 6 times as many buttons as he brought then. How many buttons did he bring last week?

follow_ups.question: This week's buttons are shared equally among 8 children. How many buttons does each child get?
Each child sews 5 of their buttons onto a sock puppet. How many buttons does each child have left over?

problem: Ruth is sewing a tiny dress for her doll and a warm winter coat for herself. The doll's dress needs 2 buttons, but the coat needs 8 to keep out the cold. The coat needs how many times as many buttons as the dress?

The sewing club is making costumes for the school play, which opens in 3 weeks. A mouse costume needs 15 sequins. The queen's gown has to sparkle under the stage lights, so it needs 9 times as many. How many sequins does the gown need?

follow_ups.question: Sequins come in bags of 45. How many bags will the club use for the gown?

problem: Lin has been in the sewing club for two years, and her pincushion holds 40 pins. Her little sister Mei has just joined, so Mei's pincushion holds half as many. How many pins does Mei have?

follow_ups.question: Lin gives Mei 6 of her pins. How many pins does Mei have now?
How many pins are left in Lin's pincushion?

problem: A large spool of white thread holds 90 metres. Kemal also keeps a small travel spool in his pencil case, and it holds 15 metres. The large spool holds how many times as much thread as the small one?

follow_ups.question: Kemal uses 5 metres from the large spool to hem a skirt. How many metres are left on that spool?
He then uses up 2 full travel spools as well. How many metres of thread has he used in all?
His whole project needs 50 metres of thread. How many more metres does he need?

problem: At her first sewing club meeting, Bea sewed 9 stitches on her cross-stitch fox. By the end of term she had become so quick that she sewed 10 times as many in a single evening. The club room always smells of fresh coffee. How many stitches did she sew that evening?

follow_ups.question: Her friend Kofi sewed 15 fewer stitches than Bea that evening. How many did Kofi sew?

problem: The fabric shelf in the club room holds 92 folded pieces of cotton. Felt is only used for puppets, so there are just a quarter as many pieces of felt. Find how many pieces of felt are on the shelf.
Theo's block tower used fewer blocks, just 4. His older sister Zainab stood on a chair to finish hers, which used 24 blocks. How many times as many blocks are in Zainab's tower as in Theo's?

follow_ups.question: Theo keeps building until his tower is twice as tall as before. How many blocks are in it now?
How many blocks shorter than Zainab's tower is Theo's tower now?

problem: Duc's first block set came with 48 small bricks. For his birthday his aunt gave him a castle set with 8 times as many bricks. The box says it is for ages 6 and up. How many bricks are in the castle set?

follow_ups.question: Nineteen castle bricks have rolled under the sofa. How many castle bricks can Duc still find?

problem: Ines built a long road across the playroom floor for her toy cars, using 30 blocks. The bridge she made over the road used a third as many blocks. How many blocks are in the bridge?

follow_ups.question: She builds a second bridge exactly like the first. How many blocks are in the two bridges together?
How many blocks has she used for the road and both bridges?

problem: A starter tub of building blocks holds 11 blocks. Schools usually buy the jumbo tub instead, which holds 99. Find how many times as many blocks are in the jumbo tub.
Aiyana laid 6 red blocks as the base of her rainbow tower. On top she stacked 7 times as many yellow blocks. Her cat watched from the windowsill the whole time. How many yellow blocks did she use?

follow_ups.question: Then the tower toppled, and 8 yellow blocks rolled under the bed. How many yellow blocks are still on the floor?

problem: Jonas built a block wall 90 centimetres long across the hallway. It is 5 times longer than the wall his little cousin built next to it. How long is his cousin's wall?

follow_ups.question: His cousin adds 12 centimetres of blocks to her wall. How long is it now?
Now Jonas's wall is how many times as long as hers?
Jonas takes 10 centimetres off his wall to make a gate. How long is his wall after that?

problem: Pablo built a garage for his toy cars that is 9 blocks wide. His toy planes needed much more room, so the airport he built is 36 blocks wide. The airport is how many times as wide as the garage?

follow_ups.question: He makes the garage 6 blocks wider. How wide is it now?
How many blocks wider is the airport than the new garage?

problem: Pupils have spent 2 weeks building a block city on the classroom floor, and it already has 34 houses. They want the city to look green, so they plan 3 times as many trees as houses. How many trees do they need?

follow_ups.question: They have built 57 trees so far. How many more trees must they build?

problem: In her racing game, Sofía collected 60 coins on the jungle track. On the ice track her kart kept sliding off the road, so she collected only half as many coins. On the ice track, what was her coin total?
Arjun's knight starts the game with 7 hearts of health. After finding the golden armour, the knight has 84 hearts. The game has 40 levels. How many times as many hearts does the knight have now?

follow_ups.question: A dragon's fire burns away 24 hearts. How many hearts does the knight have left?
A potion doubles the knight's hearts. How many hearts does the knight have now?

problem: Kai's puzzle game gives 4 stars for every easy level. The boss level is much harder, so it is worth 5 times as many stars. What is the boss level worth in stars?

follow_ups.question: Kai finishes one easy level and then beats the boss level. How many stars has he earned?

problem: Yusuf has played his farming game all summer, and his barn now holds 72 animals. Chiara, who only started last week, has a barn with a third as many animals in it. The game's music is a cheerful banjo tune. How many animals are in Chiara's barn?

follow_ups.question: If Chiara upgrades her barn, it will hold 4 times as many animals as it does now. How many would it hold then?

problem: In a space game, Erin flies a small scout ship that can carry 5 crystals. When she reaches the next planet she unlocks a cargo ship that can carry 40. How many times as many crystals does the cargo ship carry?

follow_ups.question: Erin fills the cargo ship and then sells 15 crystals. How many crystals are still on board?
Next she trades 10 crystals for a shield. How many crystals are left?
She moves the rest into scout ships, filling each one. How many scout ships does she fill?

problem: Mila scored 87 points in the dance game. Her brother Alexei has played it for years, and Mila's score was only a quarter of his. What was Alexei's score?

follow_ups.question: Their mum scored 50 points less than Alexei. What was her score?
How many points did Mila and her mum score between them?

problem: Hamza's monster team in his video game has 21 monsters. His friend Selin keeps trading monsters away, and her team is only a third as big. What is the size of Selin's team?

In her city-building game, Ava pays 9 gold coins for a wooden hut. A stone tower is much stronger and costs 81 gold coins. She has been playing for 45 minutes. The tower costs how many times as much as the hut?

follow_ups.question: Ava builds 2 huts and one tower. How much gold does she spend altogether?

problem: In Zoe's treasure board game, landing on a red square earns 3 coins. The gold square is rare, so it pays 9 times as many coins. How many coins does Zoe get for landing on the gold square?

follow_ups.question: Zoe already had 15 coins before landing there. How many coins does she have now?
She pays 6 coins to cross the troll's bridge. How many coins does she have left?

problem: The deluxe edition of the family's word game has 96 letter tiles. The travel edition, small enough for a pocket, has a quarter as many tiles. How many tiles come in the travel edition?

follow_ups.question: On a train trip, 3 players each take 7 tiles from the travel bag. How many tiles are left in the bag?
At home, the same 3 players each take 7 tiles from the deluxe bag instead. How many tiles stay in that bag?
How many more tiles are left in the deluxe bag than were left in the travel bag?

problem: Ama moved her counter 3 spaces in snakes and ladders. Kwesi landed at the foot of a ladder and climbed 12 spaces. Their dog kept trying to sit on the board. How many times as far as Ama did Kwesi move?

follow_ups.question: On his next turn Kwesi slides down a snake and goes back 5 spaces. How many spaces ahead of where he began is he after the two turns?

problem: In a card-and-board game, how many points is a legendary card worth if it is worth 7 times as much as a common card? A common card is worth 14 points.
Halfway through the property game, Dario has 32 dollars in play money. That is 4 times as much as his sister Lucia has left after paying rent at his hotel. How much money does Lucia have?

follow_ups.question: Lucia passes the start square and collects 20 dollars. How much does she have now?
How much more money does Dario still have than Lucia?

problem: Grandma and Leo played draughts for 12 minutes before dinner. Their chess game afterwards lasted 72 minutes, because Grandma thinks very carefully about every move. They ate 5 cookies while they played chess. How many times as long as the draughts game was the chess game?

follow_ups.question: The next evening their chess game was 15 minutes shorter. How long did it last?

problem: The bear in Nell's forest board game gets hungry. On a calm turn it eats 2 berry cards, but when it is angry it eats 5 times as many. How many berry cards does an angry bear eat?

follow_ups.question: Nell's pile has 25 berry cards when the bear gets angry. How many cards are left in the pile after it eats?
On the next turn the bear is calm again. How many cards are left after it eats this time?

problem: The board game café in town owns 88 games. The library down the road has just one shelf for games and lends out only a quarter as many. How many games does the library lend out?

Rosa's very first jigsaw puzzle had 10 pieces. Now she is working on one with 90 pieces. The new puzzle shows a lighthouse at sunset. The new puzzle has how many times as many pieces as her first one?

follow_ups.question: She has already placed 34 pieces of the new puzzle. How many are left to place?

problem: Faisal finished the Sunday crossword in 18 minutes. His time was only a third as long as his uncle's, who kept stopping to drink his tea. How many minutes did his uncle take?

follow_ups.question: His aunt finished 9 minutes faster than his uncle. How long did she take?
How many minutes longer than Faisal did his aunt take?
Next week Faisal wants to finish in half of today's time. What time is he aiming for?

problem: In Leah's puzzle book, the word searches fill 24 pages. The mazes are printed big, so they fill half as many pages. How many pages of mazes are there?

follow_ups.question: Leah does 3 maze pages a day. How many days will the mazes last her?
If she does the word searches at the same speed, how many days will those take?

problem: Team Owl solved 8 riddles in the first round of the museum puzzle hunt and 64 riddles by the end. The museum has 3 floors full of clues. By the end, Team Owl had solved how many times as many riddles as in the first round?

follow_ups.question: Team Fox solved 9 fewer riddles in the whole hunt than Team Owl. How many did Team Fox solve?

problem: Ji-woo solved 4 sudoku puzzles on Saturday. How many did she solve on Sunday, when the rain kept her inside and she solved 3 times as many?

The puzzle shelf at the library holds 75 jigsaw boxes. Brain teaser boxes are newer, and there are a third as many of them. The library opens at 9 every morning. How many brain teaser boxes are on the shelf?

follow_ups.question: Children borrow 8 of the brain teaser boxes. How many brain teaser boxes are left?
How many boxes of both kinds are on the shelf now?

problem: The first maze in Diego's activity book takes 2 minutes to solve. The maze on the back cover is enormous and takes him 14 minutes. How many times as long does the back-cover maze take?

follow_ups.question: Diego does the back-cover maze two more times for fun. How many minutes does that take him?

problem: At the puzzle club in the town hall, the smallest puzzle on the table has 48 pieces. The club's biggest puzzle has 9 times as many pieces. It shows a hot-air balloon over the mountains. How many pieces does the biggest puzzle have?

follow_ups.question: So far the club has put 95 pieces of the biggest puzzle together. How many pieces are still loose?

problem: The balloon seller at the carnival filled 50 balloons in the morning. His helium tank was running low after lunch, so in the afternoon he filled only half as many. How many balloons did he fill in the afternoon?

follow_ups.question: He sold the afternoon balloons for 2 dollars each. How much money did he make in the afternoon?
The morning balloons sold for the same price. How much did he make from those?
How much did he make for the whole day?

problem: On Friday night the carnival's bumper cars took 96 tickets, many more than the haunted house, which took 12. How many times as many tickets did the bumper cars take?

follow_ups.question: On Saturday the haunted house took twice as many tickets as on Friday. How many did it take on Saturday?
How many tickets did the haunted house take over the two nights?

problem: Seo-yeon landed 3 rings on bottles at the ring toss. Her dad played basketball in college and has a steady arm, so he landed 4 times as many. What was her dad's total?

Rain kept people away from the carnival on Monday. On sunny Saturday the popcorn stand sold 84 bags, which was 7 times Monday's sales. A bag of popcorn costs 3 dollars. How many bags were sold on Monday?

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday the stand sold 9 more bags than on Monday. How many bags did it sell on Tuesday?

problem: At the strongman game, Kenji swung the hammer and the puck rose 7 centimetres. The carnival worker swung next, and the puck shot up 63 centimetres. How many times as high did the worker's puck go?

follow_ups.question: The bell sits at 80 centimetres. How far below the bell did the worker's puck stop?
On his second try, Kenji's puck goes 3 times as high as on his first. How high does it go?

problem: Last weekend the carnival's face-painting booth used 16 tubes of paint. The masks in the mask-making tent need thick layers, so that tent used 5 times as many tubes. How many tubes did the mask-making tent use?

follow_ups.question: Paint comes in boxes of 8 tubes. How many boxes did the mask-making tent use?
Each box costs 9 dollars. How much did the mask tent's paint cost?
The face-painting booth bought its tubes one at a time for 2 dollars each. How much less did it spend on paint than the mask tent?

problem: The carnival's big merry-go-round has 36 horses. The little merry-go-round for toddlers has a quarter as many horses. Organ music plays while the horses go up and down. How many horses does the toddlers' ride have?

follow_ups.question: On one ride, every toddler horse has a rider except 2. How many toddlers are riding?

problem: Zuri played skee-ball all evening and won 78 tickets. Her cousin Emeka stuck to the dart game and won only 6. Find how many times as many tickets Zuri won as Emeka.
The marching band in the town parade has 9 drummers. The band leader loves brass, and the drummers number only a third as many as the trumpet players. How many trumpet players march in the band?

follow_ups.question: The band also has 5 flute players. How many musicians are in the band, counting drummers, trumpeters and flute players?
On parade day, 6 musicians stay home with colds. How many musicians march?

problem: The lead float in the harvest parade carries 54 paper lanterns, which is 6 times as many as the little float pulled by ponies. The parade route is 3 kilometres long. How many lanterns are on the little float?

follow_ups.question: Volunteers add 7 more lanterns to the little float. How many does it carry now?

problem: Ruby sat on the curb counting animals as the parade went by. She counted 4 horses pulling the mayor's carriage and 20 dogs in the dog-walkers' group. Work out how many times as many dogs as horses Ruby counted.

follow_ups.question: Each horse wears 4 horseshoes. How many horseshoes are on the carriage horses?
Each dog has four legs. How many dog legs are in the dog-walkers' group?

problem: At the start of the parade route, 47 children waved flags. The crowd in the town square was much bigger and waved 8 times as many flags. In the town square, how many flags were waved?

The clowns in the parade threw 60 sweets to the crowd. The stilt walkers had to keep their balance, so they threw only half as many. A small boy caught his sweets in his hat. How many sweets did the stilt walkers throw?

follow_ups.question: One stilt walker dropped 4 of her sweets on the road. How many of the stilt walkers' sweets reached the crowd?

problem: The giant dragon puppet in the New Year parade is carried by 32 people. The tiger puppet is much lighter and needs only 4. The dragon needs how many times more carriers than the tiger?

follow_ups.question: Each dragon carrier wears 2 red gloves. How many gloves do the dragon carriers wear?
Gloves come in boxes of 8. How many boxes are needed for the dragon carriers?
The tiger carriers each wear 2 gloves too. How many gloves do all the carriers wear together?

problem: The school float had 8 paper streamers on its railings. The bakery's float was decorated by the bakers' children, who made 4 times as many streamers in pink and white. How many streamers did the bakery float have?

follow_ups.question: The wind tore off 7 of the bakery float's streamers. How many were left?
How many more streamers did the bakery float still have than the school float?

problem: This year the town ordered 88 pots of flowers to line the parade route. The parade 2 years ago was much shorter, and this year's order is 8 times as big as the order back then. How many pots did the town order for the earlier parade?

follow_ups.question: Each pot in the earlier parade held 6 tulips. How many tulips was that?

problem: The dumpling stall at the spring festival sold 9 trays in the quiet morning. When the evening crowd arrived it sold 27 trays. Evening sales were how many times morning sales?

For the lantern festival, Xiu's family hung 24 lanterns on their balcony. The temple courtyard was decorated with 9 times as many lanterns. The festival lasts for 15 days. How many lanterns hung in the courtyard?

follow_ups.question: On the last night, 58 of the courtyard lanterns were taken down. How many were still hanging?
Xiu's family takes down a third of their lanterns. How many does the family still have up?

problem: Most children at the festival asked the face painter for butterflies, and she painted 32 of them. She painted only a quarter as many tigers. How many tigers did she paint?

follow_ups.question: She charged 3 dollars for each tiger. How much money did the tigers bring in?

problem: The main stage at the music festival is lit by 72 lamps. The small acoustic stage under the trees has just 6 lamps. The headline band plays until midnight. The main stage has how many times as many lamps as the acoustic stage?

follow_ups.question: During a thunderstorm, 15 lamps on the main stage stop working. How many still work?

problem: Sanjay brought 7 homemade candles to sell at the winter festival. His aunt has made candles for years, so she brought 6 times as many. How many candles did his aunt bring?

follow_ups.question: His aunt sold all but 9 of hers. How many did she sell?
Sanjay sold every one of his candles. How many candles did the two of them sell together?
Each candle cost 2 dollars. How much money did they make?

problem: The bread stall at the harvest festival baked 90 loaves in all, which was 5 times the number of cakes baked at the cake stall next door. How many cakes did the cake stall make?

follow_ups.question: By the afternoon the cake stall had 3 cakes left. How many had it sold?
Each cake was sold in 8 slices. How many slices were sold?

problem: At the festival's story tent, a storyteller read for 10 minutes. Then a folk band played for 40 minutes, and nobody wanted to leave. The band played how many times as long as the storyteller read?
Mika folded 13 paper boats for the festival's boat race on a pond 30 metres long. The scout troop folded 7 times as many boats. What number of boats did the scouts fold?

follow_ups.question: Of the scouts' boats, 18 sank before the finish line. How many scout boats finished?

problem: A big fishing boat came into the harbor with 40 crates of fish. A smaller boat had a slow day at sea and brought in a quarter as many crates. How many crates did the smaller boat bring in?

follow_ups.question: The smaller boat's crates are loaded onto a truck with 5 crates of crabs. How many crates are on the truck?
The truck drops off 3 crates at each restaurant. How many restaurants does it visit?

problem: A little sailboat tied up at the harbor is 8 metres long. The cargo ship docked beside it is 96 metres long. How many times as long as the sailboat is the cargo ship?

follow_ups.question: A ferry is 3 times as long as the sailboat. How long is the ferry?
How much longer is the cargo ship than the ferry?
If the ferry and the cargo ship lined up end to end, how long would the line be?

problem: Early on Monday, Aiko counted 8 seagulls on the harbor wall. When the fishing boats came back with their catch, 5 times as many gulls gathered there. The air smelled of salt and seaweed. How many gulls gathered when the boats came back?

follow_ups.question: A dog ran along the wall and 17 gulls flew away. How many gulls stayed?

problem: The new car ferry carries 84 cars on each crossing, 6 times as many as the tiny old ferry it replaced. What was the old ferry's car capacity?
At the harbor market, Jaya bought 3 crabs and her uncle bought 18 crabs for his restaurant. Together they carried the crabs to his van. How many times as many crabs did her uncle buy?

follow_ups.question: Her uncle cooks 4 of his crabs for lunch. How many of his crabs are left?
Jaya gives her crabs to her uncle as well. How many crabs does he have now?

problem: Workers at the harbor unloaded 45 containers on a quiet Monday. On Tuesday a huge ship arrived after 12 days at sea, and they unloaded 7 times as many. How many containers did they unload on Tuesday?

follow_ups.question: Trucks took away 99 of Tuesday's containers by nightfall. How many were still waiting at the dock?

problem: The lighthouse keeper climbs 80 steps to reach the lamp. The harbor master's tower is shorter and has half as many steps. How many steps lead up the harbor master's tower?

follow_ups.question: The harbor master climbs up his tower twice every day. How many steps does he climb up in a day?
How many steps does he climb up in a week?

problem: A tugboat at the harbor has a crew of 4. The cruise ship at the next pier needs a crew of 84 to look after its passengers. Find how many times as large the cruise ship's crew is.

The head teacher tied 6 balloons to the finish line of the sprint. The parents' committee thought the field looked bare, so they tied triple that number along the fence. A gentle breeze made the balloons bob up and down. How many balloons are on the fence?

follow_ups.question: Five of the fence balloons pop in the hot sun. How many are still there?

problem: Members of the harbor yacht club love sailing, so the club owns more sailboats than motorboats. It has 63 sailboats, which is 7 times as many as its motorboats. How many motorboats does the club own?

follow_ups.question: The club buys 3 new motorboats. How many motorboats does it have now?
Now how many more sailboats than motorboats does the club have?
Each motorboat is tied up with a rope 5 metres long. How many metres of rope do all the motorboats use?

problem: Bruno's old game console had a controller with 4 buttons. The new controller he got for his birthday has 16 buttons, counting the tiny ones on the back. How many times as many buttons does the new controller have?

follow_ups.question: His sister's controller has 6 fewer buttons than Bruno's new one. How many buttons does hers have?
How many buttons are on those two newer controllers together?

problem: Behind the red barn, the farmer grew 37 white pumpkins. Orange ones sell much better, so he planted 9 times as many orange pumpkins. Hayrides to that field leave every 20 minutes. Work out how many orange pumpkins he planted.

follow_ups.question: By the end of the first weekend, 85 orange pumpkins had been sold. How many were left in the field?
